en.description:
The moon is missing! Join Dino as he sets out to help his friend, with a little help from the Cloud Guardian. A gentle adventure about friendship and helping one another.

English audio with English on-screen subtitles. Choose the matching language playlist for more stories.

Produced for Family Learning Hub.
Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@familylearninghub-flh
Explore more: https://familylearninghub.com

#DinoAdventures #FamilyLearningHub #KidsStories
en.playlist_description: Dino Adventures in English, with English dialogue and on-screen subtitles. Little adventures about friendship, kindness and helping one another. Episodes are arranged in story order.
